sources.title: Manage usage credits for paid Claude plans

folds.text: Claude has a usage allowance, not a fixed number of messages. Typical limits: {{facts.limits}}. What you get depends on your plan.
The same allowance is shared across the web, desktop, mobile and Claude Code. You can see how much you have used in your settings.
What eats usage: long chats, big files, heavier models, high effort, and tools like research, web search and file creation.

items: Start a new chat for a new topic.
Put related questions into one clear message.
Pick a lighter model for simple jobs.
Use a project for documents you reuse.
Be specific, so Claude needs fewer follow-ups.

folds.question: You have a new, unrelated question. Which habit saves more usage?
options: Keep going in your long old chat
Ask three small questions in a row
folds.why: Claude keeps the whole earlier chat in view, so a long chat costs more. A fresh chat starts light.
